meta.description: Japanese nouns (名詞), organized by JLPT level.
meta.note: Covers common concrete and abstract nouns. Proper nouns, counters, and demonstratives are intentionally excluded (they live in their own data files). Kanji shown in the dictionary form; kana gives the reading.
